question: How does abstaining from food by day lead beyond age and death?
premises: This practice affects age and death.
The practitioner will go beyond death.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome age and death.
uncertainties: The idiomatic sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may imply transcending or reaching the end of death.
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome age and death.
